sentences.text:
Counsel for Applicant :- Manish Kumar Singh,B.N.Singh Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mrs. Sadhna Rani (Thakur),J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the respondent.

By means of this application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. the applicant seeks a direction to 2nd Judicial Magistrate, Court No. 18, District Jaunpur to expedite the hearing of Criminal Case as State of U.P. Vs Ashu Dubey and others arising out of Case Crime No. 412 of 2017 under Sections 498A/323/504/506/354 I.P.C. and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Barsethi, District Jaunpur in a time bound manner.

entities.text: 2nd Judicial Magistrate, Court No. 18, District Jaunpur
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: State of U.P. Vs Ashu Dubey and others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: It is stated by the learned counsel for the applicant that the trial is pending before the trial court since 2017.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the applicant's case, this application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. is finally disposed of with a direction to the 2nd Judicial Magistrate, Court No. 18, District Jaunpur to decide the aforesaid case in accordance with law without granting unnecessary adjournments to either of the parties, as expeditiously as possible, preferably within a period of six months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order, if there is no legal impediment.
